verdictStatement: PARTIAL. findings.description: Original finding: the scenario table heading said the BASE known subtotals include 'assumption-based class-B allowance and amortised tooling', but the audit then believed the figures excluded the separately amortised tooling envelope. That premise was WRONG and the finding is withdrawn. Re-inspection of cost-scenarios.json at 0eceb86 shows the COST-16 tooling/NRE line is a KNOWN category line inside the subtotal: SCN-HUB-100-BASE known lines sum to 437.13 INCLUDING COST-16 = 120.00; the standalone toolingAmortizationEur field (120.00) repeats the same amount and must not be added again. Adding it (437.13 + 120) would double count. The original D31 values were correct.
findings.correction: No data change was required. The Lead clarified the D31 heading and paragraph to state explicitly that COST-16 is included in the sum and that toolingAmortizationEur repeats it and is not added again, with the volume-1/10/100/500/1000 HUB tooling amounts. Verified accurate; the auditor's earlier 'excludes tooling' statement is corrected in D35 section 7 and in calculationsRechecked.
findings.evidence: At 0eceb86: SCN-HUB-100-BASE lines include {categoryId:COST-16, amountEur:120, status:KNOWN}; sum of KNOWN lines = 437.13; toolingAmortizationEur = 120. All 90 scenarios: toolingAmortizationEur equals the COST-16 line amount (or 0) - 0 mismatches; D31 BASE table equals sum(KNOWN lines) for 6 families x 5 volumes - 0 mismatches. D31:47-60 now states inclusion/non-addition explicitly.
findings.verification: CLOSED_VERIFIED by clarification; original finding withdrawn because its arithmetic premise double-counted tooling. No fabricated or missing data.

sourceVerification.note: Official Commission CRA page (HTTP 200, fetched during the audit of bef2f4b; not re-fetched in the correction round). Confirms in force 10 Dec 2024, main obligations 11 Dec 2027, reporting obligations from 11 Sep 2026. Supports EVD-MC11-301/417; independent verification of the CRA dates.
Official Commission CRA reporting page (HTTP 200). Confirms reporting applies from 11 Sep 2026 and the 24 h / 72 h / 14-day / one-month mechanics. Supports EVD-MC11-303.

Official NMEA page (HTTP 200). Confirms that all products reading or transmitting NMEA 2000 must be certified by NMEA, the licence model, manufacturer-code assignment up to 60 days, per-product codes, the encrypted certification file and the logo/terminology rule. Supports EVD-MC11-001/002/319.

Official NMEA page (HTTP 200). Confirms copy/licence position, 4800-baud bus, Version 4.30 (Dec 2023), USD 1,150 / 7,500 / 10,000 tiers and USD 200 manufacturer mnemonic fee. Supports EVD-MC11-003/004/320.
Manufacturer page (HTTP 200). Confirms USD 2.196 / 1.689 / 1.244 / 0.889 bands, -55 to 125 C, Automotive rating, SOIC-8. Supports EVD-MC11-102.
INACCESSIBLE to the auditor: fetch endpoint HTTP 404 / no PDF content (reproduces EVD-MC11-131). Not evidence the claim is false; no datasheet is retrieved anywhere (0/41).

Manufacturer announcement (HTTP 200). Confirms USD 60 (4 GB) / USD 80 (8 GB), 2.4 GHz quad Cortex-A76, 802.11ac, BT 5.0/BLE, GbE, PCIe 2.0 x1, 40-pin GPIO, RTC, 5 V/5 A, ~12 W pathological peak, sole first-party OS. Supports EVD-MC11-005/006/018.

Manufacturer page (HTTP 200). Confirms active/volume production, Cortex-M7 480 MHz, 2 MB flash / 1 MB RAM, 1.62-3.6 V, 2x CAN FD, watchdogs, RTC, 3x ADC, Ethernet MAC, 2.95 uA standby. Supports EVD-MC11-012.
Manufacturer page (HTTP 200). Every listed MAX-M10 variant is marked 'This product is not longer available'. Supports the EOL finding EVD-MC11-116 and CMP-GNSS-01/02/03.
Manufacturer page (HTTP 200). Confirms status 'Not Recommended for new designs', ECC-P256/SHA-256/AES-128-GCM, up to 16 keys, <150 nA sleep, 2.0-5.5 V. Supports EVD-MC11-014/112/508.
Service manufacturer page (HTTP 200). Confirms 'From $2.00 / 5 pcs', 24-hour build, PCBA 'From $8.00', SMT stencil 'From $3.00', ISO 27001/27701 and PCI DSS. Supports EVD-MC11-124/204.
Service manufacturer page (HTTP 200). Confirms PCBs made in Europe 'starting at just EUR 14.20' and one-business-day manufacturing. Supports EVD-MC11-126 (the single EUR manufacturer-list price).

INACCESSIBLE to the auditor: fetch endpoint HTTP 404 on two attempts, so EVD-MC11-109 (the only EUR authorised-distributor price series) could not be independently reproduced. Not proof the claim is false; recorded as inaccessible and as an evidence-strength limitation.
